title: Synthetic assembly policy
text: Coordinate conversion is directional. A GRCh37 variant must be lifted to GRCh38 before GRCh38-only annotation, and alleles must be reverified after liftover.

title: Synthetic variant identity policy
text: Variant identity preserves assembly, sequence accession version, coordinate convention, position, reference allele, and alternate allele. Dense similarity never overrides these exact fields.

title: Synthetic phenotype policy
text: Phenotype matching is independent of coordinate normalization and can be executed while the molecular branch is being prepared.
